name: IIMO
description:
IIMO is a full-stack platform I designed and built to help photographers manage their business end-to-end.

  It covers shoot lifecycle management (active → expiring → expired → archived), client organisation, photo uploads with automatic watermark compositing, usage rights definition with contract PDF uploads, and secure shareable preview links for clients.

 I also built an in-app notification system for expiring rights and a public shoot preview page that works without a login. The stack is Next.js 16 (App Router), TypeScript, Tailwind CSS 4, and Supabase for the database, auth, and file storage.

name: Artbox Studio
description:
For version 2 of artbox-site, I built a modern website using Next.js 15, React 19, and Tailwind CSS v4. Here's what I did:

Technical build — I set up a TypeScript component-based architecture with a responsive UI, mobile navigation with dropdowns, smooth animations, and dark/light mode support.

Developer documentation — I wrote comprehensive guides to help developers transition from vanilla JS to React, including JSX explanations, side-by-side code comparisons, and practical examples for common patterns.

Development standards — I established a structured Git workflow with branching rules (no direct commits to main), TypeScript conventions, mobile-first testing practices, and clear npm scripts for day-to-day development.

My main focus was on onboarding and code quality — making it easy for new developers to get up to speed while keeping the codebase maintainable.

name: 3D Demos
description:
A portfolio of 10 isolated 3D demos built with React Three Fiber and Next.js 15, each showcasing a distinct real-world technique used in production 3D web experiences.

Highlights include:

Scroll-driven 3D animation using GSAP ScrollTrigger — synchronizing camera movement and mesh rotation with user scroll for a campaign-style narrative feel
GLTF/GLB model loading with Draco compression, contact shadows, and runtime model switching
Per-material colour customisation on a real shoe model using Leva GUI controls
HTML annotations overlaid on 3D objects in world space
Pointer-based camera lerp rig and keyboard-driven scene navigation

name: Houzen
description:
Here's what I did on Houzen:

Technical build — I built a promotional website using React (bootstrapped with Create React App), written in JavaScript. I implemented a fully responsive layout, adapting a desktop-only design to work across all screen sizes — including designing the mobile experience myself since no mobile mockup was provided.

Features built — I developed a dual-purpose site covering app promotion with download links, app feature information, and a dedicated company information page.

name: Dimensional
description: I built a React app that integrates with the TMDB (The Movie Database) API to fetch live movie data. I implemented an API call to retrieve the top 5 upcoming movies and built a slideshow/carousel component within the UI to display them dynamically.
